name: Patent Race
description: A short, sharp tech sprint. A TechLeader rival is pouring every spare dollar into R&D on its hero product (car) and flanking with televisions on the side. You have three years — maybe four — to put both tech-tier goods on the shelf, crack the Eastside car market, and stay ahead in value. No long grinds, no brand moats: just a race.

goals.description: Put televisions on a shelf — the electronics-parts supply chain is the price of admission.
Put cars on a shelf — match the TechLeader's hero product head-to-head.
Reach 20% share of car in Eastside — crack their High-bracket stronghold even as they premium-price the aisle.
Grow corporate value to $35M — finish the race ahead on the scoreboard, not just on the shelves.
Complete the sprint in 42 months — this isn't a marathon.
